claims.quote: proline-rich transmembrane protein (PRRT)2 has been identified as the causative gene for several paroxysmal neurological disorders.
an important role of PRRT2 in synapse development and function has emerged.

claims.object_text: impairs the formation of synaptic contacts and neurotransmitter release
claims.quote: Knock down of the protein strongly impairs the formation of synaptic contacts and neurotransmitter release.

claims.object_text: endows synaptic vesicle exocytosis with Ca2+ sensitivity by interacting with proteins of the fusion complex and with the Ca2+ sensors synaptotagmins
claims.quote: At the nerve terminal, PRRT2 endows synaptic vesicle exocytosis with Ca2+ sensitivity by interacting with proteins of the fusion complex and with the Ca2+ sensors synaptotagmins (Syts).
In the postsynaptic compartment, PRRT2 interacts with glutamate receptors.
